# cmark-gfm (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm
Tag: `0.29.0.gfm.13`
Commit: `587a12bb54d95ac37241377e6ddc93ea0e45439b`
License: see COPYING.

C sources, headers and generated scanner `.inc` files from `src` (excluding CLI main.c) and
`extensions`, plus the config/version/export headers generated by upstream CMake
on macOS with CMARK_SHARED=OFF and CMARK_STATIC=ON. Package.swift and module.modulemap
provide an offline Swift Package target named libcmark. No WebKit or runtime downloads.

Local patch: `Sources/libcmark/autolink.c` ends bare URLs at common CJK prose
punctuation, curly quotes, or Unicode whitespace. An unmatched closing parenthesis
also ends a URL when followed by Unicode prose or a comma.
This prevents adjacent prose from becoming part of the link. Balanced ASCII
parentheses, Unicode letters and percent-encoded punctuation remain valid URL
content. Explicit Markdown links and angle-bracket autolinks are unaffected;
use those forms when a destination intentionally includes prose punctuation.
Regression coverage is in `Tests/QuickLook/main.swift`.
